title_concept: The Unseen Battle of Blockbuster and Netflix
story: In the late 1990s, Blockbuster ruled the video rental market, but small startup Netflix was brewing a storm with its subscription model. When Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for a mere $50 million, Blockbuster saw no value in it and dismissed the opportunity. The irony of this decision would define the future of home entertainment.
hook: What happened when the giant Blockbuster underestimated a tiny startup that would later change the way we consume movies forever?
why_it_works: The story has a classic rivalry element, showcasing how a big player can fail to adapt to innovation and ultimately lose it all.
